L5·N2883unmasked layer
Mostly a suppression unit in blog-comment/forum threads: it goes strongly negative on the opening tokens of a reply turn ("Yes", "I", "'ll", the period ending "Thanks for pointing this out."), while its (weak) positive peaks sit on the closing punctuation/newline or final praise word that ends a chatty comment.

L5·N10520unmasked layer
Weak, polysemantic "clause-onset" detector: it peaks on the first token of a new clause/statement right after an introductory phrase, comma, dash, or line break in explanatory/instructional prose (e.g. "…hard to come by, **we** can look…", newline + "**Your** dialogue should…", "- **select** the default version").
